name: SPIDER-MAN
description: An ordinary young man from New York balances his studies with protecting the city from crime, guided by one rule: “With great power comes great responsibility.”
details: Peter often relies on his spider-sense to detect danger and uses web-shooters that he built himself.

name: IRON MAN
description: Genius inventor and billionaire Tony Stark builds a high-tech suit of armor to escape captivity. He later uses his inventions to protect the world.
details: Tony uses the identity of Iron Man. His armor has changed over the years to meet different challenges.

name: CAPTAIN AMERICA
description: Armed with a vibranium shield, Captain America stands for justice, honor, and courage. He inspires the Avengers and brings the team together.
details: Steve Rogers received the Super-Soldier Serum during World War II and later joined the Avengers.

name: THOR
description: The mighty god of thunder from Asgard protects both his homeland and Earth. Thor combines incredible strength with a sense of duty, fighting alongside the Avengers.
details: Thor wields Mjolnir, a hammer enchanted so that only those worthy of its power can lift it.

name: BLACK PANTHER
description: T’Challa is the king and protector of Wakanda, one of the most technologically advanced nations on Earth. He defends his people by combining ancestral traditions with advanced technology.
details: T’Challa’s home, Wakanda, is closely associated with vibranium, the metal used in much of its technology.

name: WOLVERINE
description: Logan is a mutant with a powerful healing factor and adamantium claws. After escaping the Weapon X program, he joined the X-Men.
details: Logan’s healing factor helped him survive the Weapon X procedure that bonded adamantium to his skeleton.
